_about: Hand-worked examples for overflow_time and heat_up_rate (Phase 4 plan Q10). Base plant: backend/tests/schema/fixtures/example_mixing_unit.json. The facts below are SYNTHETIC, added only for this fixture (allowed for the example plant), and are applied to a copy of it in the test.

plant_facts_used.L-12.to_id: MX-1 (the only line into MX-1 with a flow; L-STM carries steam and has none)

overflow_time.rule: minutes = (1 - normal/100) x volume x density / flow x 60; density = the lowest of the contents (SIH 1000 < KOH 1500), named; confirmed if < 60 min, else none; threshold comparison: within relative 1e-9 counts as equal (not below)

variants.name: level 80 %: exactly 60 min, boundary -> none
variants.float_note: Evaluated in this order in floating point it gives 59.999999999999986, which a plain '< 60' would wrongly confirm. Threshold comparisons treat a value within a relative 1e-9 of the threshold as equal to it, so this is NOT below 60: verdict none.

heat_up_rate.rule: C/min = duty_kW x 60 / (volume x lowest density x lowest heat capacity); minutes to limit = (design_max - normal) / rate; confirmed if < 60 min
